name: Last Supper
source:
You get out of work, one night, and you get hungry. You found this restaurant, where this waiter, Joshua, works here. Do you want to get close to him?

[From [url=https://mad-nyx.itch.io/last-supper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天晚上，你下班了，你饿了。你找到了这家餐厅，这位服务员Joshua就在这里工作。你想靠近他吗？

[来自[url=https://mad-nyx.itch.io/last-supper]Itch.io[/url]]
